senses.gloss:
झष् €1 U. (झषति-ते)
—1 To take.
—2 To put on, wear.
—3 To hurt or kill (only P. in this sense).

झषः —1 A fish in general; झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि Bg. 10. 31; cf.
 words like झषकेतन below.
—2 A large fish.
—3 The sign Pisces of the zodiac.
—4 Heat, warmth.
—5 The sign Capricornus of the zodiac.

झषः + .{@-षम्@}
—1 A forest, wood.
—2 A desert, dreary forest.
.━{@Comp.@}: झषाङ्कः, झषकेतनः, झषकेतुः, झषध्वजः, झषाशनः, झषोदरी, झषराजः
